description.value: The Black Clover is a downtown Prince George Irish pub offering authentic Irish-inspired cuisine alongside an extensive selection of spirits, a 10-tap 'Brass Cascade' draught system featuring Irish and domestic craft brews, and a revolving wine list. It bills itself as Prince George's newest downtown gathering spot with a traditional Public House atmosphere — quiet corners, live entertainment, and an unpretentious service ethos.
